description: Compact 3-column grid for short feature/value-prop items. Best when the page has many features to cover and screen real estate matters. Two variants: 'default' (boxed cards), 'minimal' (no boxes, top-rule + numeric index — fits editorial / studio / restaurant pages).

title.hint: Section headline. Omit if the section runs unannotated under another section.

items.type: array<{ title: string, description: string, icon?: string }>
items.hint: Exactly 3 items (or multiples of 3) for clean grid. title 2-5 words, description 1-2 sentences (15-30 words). icon is a single emoji or short letter (used in 'default' variant only).

variant.hint: 'default' = boxed cards with hover. 'minimal' = top-rule + indexed (01/02/03), no boxes, editorial feel — pairs well with hero-centered.
